A1.justification: Both 16-page PDFs describe the same Activation Replay work. Their text, equations, figures, tables and supplementary Sections A-D are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original benchmark evaluations, perturbation and intervention experiments, Pass@K results, ablations and supplementary runtime measurements.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical studies, including the supplementary analyses, and reports revised VisualProbe results in main Table 3.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same learnable token additions, low-entropy selection, KL-divergence objective and test-time update procedure.

E1.justification: The mathematical, knowledge, agentic and video evaluation coverage is unchanged. VisualProbe Medium and Hard already appear in v3; their revised scores introduce no new coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout. Main Table 3 retains VisualProbe results for Qwen2.5-VL-7B and DeepEyes-7B alongside DeepEyes with replay.

E3.justification: The stated model sizes, decoding procedures, judges, 16-frame video setting and Pass@K evaluation setup are unchanged. No protocol revision is documented alongside the changed VisualProbe scores.

E4.justification: The perturbation and intervention studies, threshold and strength ablations, alternative replay comparisons and case studies are unchanged, including supplementary Sections C-D.

E5.justification: Sampling descriptions and shaded bands in the perturbation plots are unchanged. Neither version introduces different repeated-run, seed or statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Main Table 3 substantially revises all VisualProbe Medium/Hard scores: Qwen2.5-VL-7B changes from 72.0/67.9 to 26.0/23.9, DeepEyes-7B from 82.1/75.4 to 29.8/35.1, and replay from 84.7/75.9 to 32.8/35.9. Replay gains change from 2.6/0.5 to 3.0/0.8. These are large numerical revisions without an accompanying explanation; other results, including the old values in main Figure 1, remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1-6 are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about RLVR shifting low-entropy activations, training-free reasoning improvements and improved Pass@K.

C2.justification: Interpretations of low-entropy replay, direct-intervention limitations, overthinking and computational overhead remain unchanged. No new interpretation explains the revised VisualProbe results.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions, hyperparameters, sampling temperature, runtime disclosures and code-access information are unchanged. No reproducibility details accompany the revised scores.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Reference 29 only updates its access date.

P1.justification: The arXiv version/date stamp is updated, and reference 29's access date changes from May 8 to August 27, 2026. Scientific prose, section organization and supplementary text are unchanged.

P2.justification: Scientific figures, captions, table structures and placement are unchanged. Main Table 3 changes only numerical entries; the body layout is preserved.

improvement.justification: In v3, main Table 3 and Figure 1 agree on VisualProbe results. In v4, the table reports replay scores of 32.8/35.9 while the figure retains 84.7/75.9; supplementary Section A also retains 75.9 versus 75.4. The unexplained revisions introduce an internal inconsistency that weakens reporting reliability. The method and remaining evidence are unchanged, limiting the deterioration.
